research.name: React-Transition-State
research.note: Dependency-free React hook that drives CSS enter and exit transitions through a seven-status state machine, including mounting and unmounting.

effects: preEnter and preExit one-tick statuses so CSS transitions can start from unmounted or display:none
useTransitionMap hook managing keyed transition states with allowMultiple

unverified: The live demo at https://szhsin.github.io/react-transition-state/ is a client-rendered page that returned only an empty root element without a browser, so the library was not seen running.
The only README image is a state diagram, not a screenshot or recording; the signature items are API behaviours read from the README, and no visual effect was observed.
